gloss: somewhat thin; on the slim side; slender

definitions.gloss: somewhat thin; on the thin/slim side; slender
definitions.explanation: Indicates something or someone is a little thinner or slimmer than average. The め suffix softens the adjective, creating a moderate, approximate expression.

examples.japanese: {細|ほそ}めのネクタイを{選|えら}ぶ。
パスタは{細|ほそ}めが{好|す}みです。
{彼女|かのじょ}は{細|ほそ}めの{体型|たいけい}で、どんな{服|ふく}もよく{似合|にあ}う。
examples.english: She has a slim build, and any clothes look good on her.

notes:
Formed by adding the suffix め to the adjective {細|ほそ}い. The め suffix creates a softer, approximate expression. Can describe objects (thin noodles, slim pens) and people's body types (slender).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {細|ほそ}めの{麺|めん}: thinner noodles
- {細|ほそ}めの{体型|たいけい}: a slender build
- {細|ほそ}めに{切|き}る: to cut into thinner pieces
- {細|ほそ}めのパンツ: slim-fit pants

RELATED WORDS:
- {太|ふと}め: on the thick side — the opposite
- {短|みじか}め: on the short side — same pattern
- {薄|うす}め: on the thin/light side — same pattern, for thickness or concentration
